title: On the Limits of LLM-as-Judge for Scientific Novelty Assessment
focus_en: Builds author-anchored research questions from papers and their cited backgrounds, then compares generated questions through standalone and comparative LLM judging and blinded expert evaluation.
focus_zh: 根据论文及其引用背景构建以作者研究为参照的问题，通过独立评分、比较式 LLM 评审和专家盲评，检验生成问题及新颖性评价的可靠性。
boundary_en: Author-anchored questions are reference points, not the only valid questions. Expert and model novelty judgments disagree; proposal feasibility, execution outcomes, and scientific importance are not established by these scores.
boundary_zh: 作者问题是参照而非唯一有效答案；专家与模型对新颖性的判断存在分歧。这些分数不能确立方案可行性、执行结果或科学重要性。

title: AgentIdeaBench: Benchmarking Scientific Ideation in the Agent Era
focus_en: Compares scientific hypothesis generation from supplied references with agent-controlled literature exploration, using shared subfields, output formats, and critics that retrieve prior art before scoring ideas.
focus_zh: 比较给定参考文献与智能体自主文献探索两种科学假设生成设置，统一研究子领域、输出格式和检索已有工作后进行评分的评审器。
boundary_en: Active exploration also changes sequential reasoning and information access. Scores remain model judgments, with limited expert validation; the generated hypotheses are not experimentally verified discoveries.
boundary_zh: 主动探索同时改变顺序推理和信息获取方式。分数仍是模型判断，专家验证有限；生成的假设并非经过实验验证的发现。

title: PostTrainBench: Can LLM Agents Automate LLM Post-Training?
focus_en: Tests whether agents can improve a supplied base language model on a target benchmark within ten hours on one H100, allowing autonomous data curation, method choice, and experiment execution.
focus_zh: 检验智能体能否在单张 H100、十小时预算内，通过自主数据构建、方法选择和实验执行，提升给定基础语言模型在目标 benchmark 上的表现。
boundary_en: Base models and target benchmarks are supplied, so results measure bounded post-training rather than question selection. Leaderboard versions change scoring and integrity rules; official instruct-model baselines are not compute-matched.
boundary_zh: 基础模型和目标 benchmark 由环境给定，衡量的是受限预算下的后训练，而非选题能力。排行榜版本会调整评分与完整性规则；官方 instruct-model 基线未匹配训练计算预算。
